_purpose: Deterministic, entirely synthetic EUR test data for Enable Banking's Mock ASPSP sandbox (https://enablebanking.com/docs -- Mock ASPSP is available in all countries, requires no credentials, and is configurable through the Enable Banking Control Panel). Enable Banking's own official sample dataset is DKK; Finance Planner imports EUR, so this dataset was built fresh rather than adapted from it. Contains no real personal or bank information -- every name, IBAN-shaped value, and identifier below is fabricated for this test only.
_shape: Shaped as Enable Banking account-information API response objects (account, balance, transaction) using the field names confirmed against the current official API reference during this pass: transaction_amount.amount is an ABSOLUTE decimal string, credit_debit_indicator (CRDT/DBIT) carries direction, entry_reference is the ASPSP transaction identifier, status is BOOK (booked) or PDNG (pending). This is NOT a confirmed Enable Banking Control Panel bulk-import format -- no such schema was available to derive from -- it is a manual-configuration reference and a reusable fixture shape for tests.
